questions.question: Which Hanshin Tigers player captured baseball's Triple Crown during the 2026 Nippon Professional Baseball campaign?
questions.explanation: Teruaki Satō accomplished the rare feat by winning the Triple Crown while competing for the Hanshin Tigers.
questions.context: 2026 Nippon Professional Baseball season: In baseball, Teruaki Satō of the Hanshin Tigers wins the Triple Crown.

questions.question: Who became the first Asian to be appointed dean of the College of Cardinals after Pope Leo XIV approved his election?
questions.explanation: Pope Leo XIV confirmed the appointment of Filipino cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, marking the first time an Asian cleric has headed the papal electing body.
questions.context: Pope Leo XIV approves Filipino cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle's election as dean of the College of Cardinals, making him the first Asian to lead the body that elects a new pope.

questions.question: Near which community in the American state of Florida did Hurricane Isaias make landfall before decreasing in intensity to category 1?
questions.explanation: Hurricane Isaias reached the Florida coast close to Destin, subsequently diminishing to category 1 strength.
questions.context: 2026 Atlantic hurricane season > Hurricane Isaias: Isaias makes landfall near Destin, Florida, and weakens to a category 1 hurricane.

questions.question: Which European nation deported Russian military commentator Mikhail Zvinchuk and four compatriots citing national security concerns?
questions.explanation: Authorities in Montenegro apprehended the five Russian citizens in Risan before expelling them for reasons linked to national security.
questions.context: Montenegro–Russia relations: Montenegro expels Russian military blogger Mikhail Zvinchuk and four other Russian nationals on national security grounds after detaining them in Risan.

questions.question: Which South African jurist and former UN human rights chief was named the recipient of the Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.explanation: Navi Pillay received the prestigious honour in recognition of her lifelong work advocating for international law and peace.
questions.context: 2026 Nobel Peace Prize: South African judge and former United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay is awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for "her efforts to promote peace and international law".
